method: Independent derivation and numerical checks, separate from rendered text
claims: A fixed angular ray bundle from a point source intersects similar parallel patches whose linear dimensions scale with distance. Area scales with distance squared, so conserved power divided by area falls as inverse distance squared.

Displayed patch geometry is an affine projection. Near/far cross-sections show the same ray bundle, not sequential opaque screens. Subdivisions remain on the same patch without a separate inset. Clear space, steady point source, no focusing or absorption; energy per area is not subjective brightness.

checks.description: Projected patch determinants scale by square
Four and nine cells partition their respective patches
Same power gives quarter and ninth irradiance

limitations: Numerical samples verify implementation consistency, not a substitute for the stated general arguments.
